source_decomposition_rows: official GAP Character Table Library U4(2) mod-2 decomposition matrix; ordinary rows chi1..chi20 matched to the frozen Atlas-labelled PSp ordinary character from Pass4745
theorem: The exact characteristic-two Brauer semisimplification of the 5671-dimensional invariant-flag H1 is 71*1 + 70*4a + 70*4b + 154*6 + 70*14 + 56*20a + 56*20b + 14*64. Combined with the exact four-dimensional trivial socle and one-dimensional trivial head, at least 66 trivial composition factors are forced into internal nonsplit layers, proving Loewy length at least three.
boundary: The composition-factor census and trivial-layer constraints are exact. A decomposition matrix does not determine the complete radical/socle ordering of the nontrivial simple factors; that remains a genuine 5671-dimensional MeatAxe problem.
